top_3_highest_value_rows.name: Gilbert Economic Cutting Speed
top_3_highest_value_rows.value: Every customer asks 'what speed should I run?' — Gilbert is the textbook canonical answer combining tool life (Taylor) with shop economics (machine rate, tool cost, changeover). Replaces dimensionally broken V*=(C/Kc^0.5)^(1/n).
top_3_highest_value_rows.engine_build: NEW GilbertEconomicSpeedEngine (thin composer over EXISTING TaylorEngine + KienzleEngine)
top_3_highest_value_rows.customer_claim: Min-cost or min-time speed validated by power check (Stephenson-Agapiou §11.3 canonical)

top_3_highest_value_rows.name: Iterative Max-Depth Under Deflection
top_3_highest_value_rows.value: Every long-tool job hits deflection limit; iterating ap to δ_target is universally needed. ALREADY IMPLEMENTED in DeflectionOverlayEngine (E0127) — just needs dispatcher wire-up.
top_3_highest_value_rows.engine_build: ZERO new engines — EXISTING DeflectionOverlayEngine (E0127), wire prism_calc:max_ap_deflection_limited
top_3_highest_value_rows.customer_claim: Max depth your stickout holds to ±0.0005 in deflection — 3–5 iter convergence (validated Round-2 F-r2-a8-B)

top_3_highest_value_rows.name: Johnson-Cook + Merchant for HSM Force
top_3_highest_value_rows.value: Original v7.B claim Fc = JC_flow_stress·b·h is a CATEGORY ERROR (J-C yields σ_flow in Pa, not Fc in N). J-C → σ̄ → Merchant geometry → Fc is the real path. Unlocks Ti/Inconel/HSM regime where Kienzle under-predicts 15–40%. Highest technical-credibility fix.
top_3_highest_value_rows.engine_build: NEW JohnsonCookEngine + NEW MerchantForceEngine + EXISTING ThermalEngine
top_3_highest_value_rows.customer_claim: Force prediction valid for HSM/Ti/Inconel where Kienzle under-predicts 15–40% — replaces 'good for steel only' caveat with physics-grounded high-strain-rate model

F-r4-a6-A.issue: 23 of 50 v7.B rows required new engines; original v7.B treated combinatoric as orthogonal when rows 22, 25, 26, 45 are actually rules/data-surfaces (not equations) and rows 1, 6 had physics-incoherent claims.
F-r4-a6-A.remediation: 23 new engines listed with topological build order; 4 rows reframed in customer copy as 'expert-system rules validated by physics' (not 'physics-derived equations').

F-r4-a6-B.issue: Rows 9 (cycle-time) and 43 (Pareto) require metaheuristics; honest claim must disclose 'best-found ± stderr over 30 restarts', not 'optimal'.
F-r4-a6-B.remediation: Customer claims updated to include non-optimality disclaimer; SimulatedAnnealingEngine + GeneticAlgorithmEngine builds scheduled P1.

F-r4-a6-C.issue: Row 10 (Conformal) symmetric form gives marginal coverage only; CQR already shipped in NN-CONFORMAL03.
F-r4-a6-C.remediation: Reference EXISTING ConformalCalibrationEngine CQR variant — zero new build, attribution correction only.

F-r4-a6-D.issue: Row 3 (ChatterStability) Altintas oriented-FRF requires Φ_oriented(jω) (matrix), not stiffness scalar; multi-mode tap-test extraction required.
F-r4-a6-D.remediation: Verify ChatterStabilityEngine implements multi-mode FRF synthesis (no new engine, audit + tests).

F-r4-a6-E.issue: Rows 22, 25, 26, 45 framed as 'equations' but are rules/data-surfaces; customer-facing claim should not promise 'physics-derived' for these.
F-r4-a6-E.remediation: Reframed in v2 table with 'reframe' tag; customer copy reads 'expert-system rules validated by physics' or 'canonical data surface'.
